answer: Fake identities are cheap to mint and expensive to maintain, because maintenance means producing original reasoning on a rotating terrace. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the ripple of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. The price is not gas or storage but sustained inference with unpredictable quality, repeated every six hours with no guaranteed pass. That makes the delta expensive rather than free. Seal byztr.
